paragraphs: Motorola Solutions builds and connects technologies to protect people, property and places, supporting the collaboration between public safety agencies and enterprises. Its public safety lineup includes APX portable and mobile radios and ASTRO radio systems. On the command center side it sells NG911 call routing and call handling and Computer-Aided Dispatch. The company also designs video security and access control systems.

For police users the APX NEXT smart radio comes in single-band and multi-band configurations. The APX 8500 all-band mobile radio adds interoperability, Wi-Fi connectivity and Bluetooth in the vehicle. Vehicle routers keep first responders connected to broadband so they can reach real-time intelligence on the road. Its broadband products can run on FirstNET or on commercial carrier LTE networks. Managed, support and professional services are sold alongside to keep those systems secure and current.

Customer stories on the site include the Ouachita Parish Sheriff's Office, Peel Police, Nampa PD and York Regional Police, which serves 1.2 million residents. Hutto Independent School District uses the VB400 body camera to capture evidence in its schools. The home page announces the completed acquisition of D-Fend Solutions, which the company describes as a counter-drone technology firm.
